correctness.rationale: A formal power-series identity shows that at exactly three positive species, matching first and quadratic power sums makes every coefficient of the expected-richness difference for integer sample sizes >=3 have the fixed sign of the difference of the third elementary symmetric functions of the miss probabilities; vanishing means identical multisets. One and two species are immediate. The exact four-species counterexample has equal squares 153/441 and difference numerator 2*19^k+13^k+12^k-20^k-17^k-15^k-11^k. Exact integers certify its sign at k=3..13, while 20^14>2*19^14 and 17^k+15^k>13^k+12^k prove negativity for every k>=14. Common-species augmentation proves existence for all m>4. An independent exact multinomial occupancy enumeration agrees at six sampling efforts; a finite ternary grid is only a diagnostic.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The Lande condition cannot directly imply a reversal between communities with equal total richness and exactly equal Simpson index: it assumes inequalities in both summary statistics. Thompson demonstrates a general possibility of crossings but gives neither the matched-statistic specification nor a minimal support size. Chao identifies the framework but no implication to sign constancy at three species. A separate argument and exact construction are necessary.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the sharp three-versus-four species boundary under simultaneously equal true richness and equal Gini-Simpson index, with an integer-sample-complete explicit witness. Primary literature covers the accumulation formula, different-richness/different-Simpson crossings, and sampling-effort phenomena, not the combined moment-matched dimension cutoff in the read material. Related broad ordering work is a residual semantic-equivalence risk and requires independent bibliographic confirmation.
residual_risks: A previous moment-matched rarefaction-order theorem may appear under power majorization, Laplace transform order, or Schur-convexity rather than ecological language.
Complete text of Tóthmérész (1995) and Liu et al. (2007) was not accessible here; their full implications have not been excluded.
Absence of a retrieved exact four-frequency table cannot establish global uniqueness or priority; independent literature review remains necessary.

value.rationale: Both species count and Gini-Simpson diversity are standard summary metrics for comparing assemblages, and they equalize the infinite-sample asymptote and the expected two-draw discovery count. Whether standardized sampling effort can still reverse expected richness rankings is a motivated conceptual gap in biodiversity comparison. A sharp minimal dimension, universal ternary obstruction and explicit exact phase-separated four-species family quantify precisely what these summaries fail to control. The result is not a new estimator, a claim about data significance, or a mere reformulation of a known low-richness/higher-Simpson crossing condition.
